title: Ant bank: does the shaped one read as built?
question: Which bank looks like something was built, rather than just dug out?
context_md:
Both are the same colony on the same bank at the same four moments, seed 1, digging the same amount. The only difference is whether the ants can feel the **shape of the ground** under them when they put a pellet down.

What to look at is the **face and the heap at its foot** — the nest itself is inside the bank and the renderer cannot show it (tunnel interior spans 119 of 255 in luminance; that is a known limit, not this change).

Across twelve of these, feeling the shape makes the hollow inside **rounder** (10 of 12 seeds) and **smaller** (12 of 12) for the same digging. The control arm is not "switched off" — it feels a *constant* shape, so both arms drop equally often and only the sense of where differs.

The honest doubt: a smaller nest may be worse, and no number here can say. That is the question.

items.label: A - constant shape (control)
items.caption: the ants feel the same ground everywhere

items.label: B - feels the real shape
items.caption: the ants feel bulges and hollows
